expansion_records.rationale: The frozen API baseline is one exact read-only response observation; it needs one independently executable smoke scenario, not parameterization.

The same visible-result mechanism is independently exercised by the ordinary UI smoke and by its frozen critical evidence variant. They remain separate Cases because the critical variant has an additional heading assertion and video-evidence requirement; this is not a business-data parameterization.

case_templates.title: API Item Lookup returns the exact frozen fixture response
preconditions: The isolated local fixture endpoint is available for this formal Batch.
Use only the frozen fixture baseline; this Case makes no claim about a real product or persistent data.

steps.action: Using the formal TypeScript + Vitest script with Node native fetch, send GET /api/items/1 to the isolated fixture endpoint.

assertions.expected: The response HTTP status is exactly 200.
The complete response JSON is exactly {"id":"1","name":"Smoke item","status":"ready"}; the id value has JSON string type.

evidence_requirements: Redacted request/response JSON for this Case.
Vitest JSON report for the formal Case run.

case_templates.title: UI Item Lookup displays the frozen item result
case_templates.target_action: Click Load item and observe the visible #result text
preconditions: The isolated fixture Item lookup page is available and exposes the Load item button.
Use only the frozen fixture baseline; do not assert refresh persistence or real-product semantics.

steps.action: Using the formal TypeScript + Playwright Test script, open the isolated fixture Item lookup page and click Load item.

assertions.expected: The visible #result text is exactly Smoke item — ready.

evidence_requirements: Key-result screenshot showing the loaded result.
Playwright JSON report for the formal Case run.

case_templates.title: Critical UI Item Lookup shows the frozen result and records video
case_templates.target_action: Check the Item lookup heading, click Load item, and observe the visible #result text
preconditions: The isolated fixture Item lookup page is available and exposes the Item lookup heading and Load item button.
Use only the frozen fixture baseline; this Case makes no refresh-persistence claim.

steps.action: Using the formal TypeScript + Playwright Test script, open the isolated fixture Item lookup page.
After checking the heading, click Load item.

assertions.expected: Before clicking Load item, the Item lookup heading is visible.
After clicking Load item, the visible #result text is exactly Smoke item — ready.

evidence_requirements: Key-result screenshot showing the heading and loaded result.
Non-empty Playwright video for this critical Case.
Playwright JSON report for the formal Case run.

execution_instances.variation: One read-only request for the fixed fixture item id string 1.
Ordinary UI smoke: load the fixed fixture item and observe its visible result.
Critical evidence variant: check the heading, load the same fixed item, and retain a non-empty video.

test_cases_self_review.review_boundary: This self-review checks only the frozen repository-local smoke baseline and its case structure; it is not user confirmation of real-business requirements or Case confirmation in Router.
